title: Martha Stewart Living
description:

Jams and jellies; fruits; composting; painting garden tools.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:

Potted vegetable garden; fishing on Long Island Sound; cooking fish.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S1 E3 — Flower Pots; Knot Herb Garden; Picnic Sandwiches
Herb garden; circular submarine sandwiches; aloe vera.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S3 E13 — Muffins
Giant bran muffins filled with raisins; citrusy mini orange muffins; healthy morning muffins; plum-filled coffee cake muffins; glazed zucchini muffins.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E1 — Citrus
Orange chiffon cake; Shaker lemon pie; lime squares with pistachio Graham cracker crust; upside-down cake made with three kinds of citrus.

title: Martha Bakes

Cranberry tart with currant jelly and cognac; mini chocolate whoopie pies; New York crumb cake; babka.

title: Martha Bakes
description:

Pumpkin pecan pie; cheesecake swirled with pumpkin; pumpkin bread; deep dish pumpkin pie.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E4 — Nuts
Traditional linzertorte; oatmeal cookies with a peanut butter filling; walnut cake; pecan tart.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E5 — Caramel
Six-layer chocolate cake filled with salted caramel; dulce de leche; pound cake with caramel glaze; chocolate-caramel bar cookies.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E3 — How to Properly Cook an Egg
Meet Martha in one of her favorite places on the farm - the chicken coop to talk about one of her favorite things to eat - eggs; Martha will share her top methods for making an egg-cellent breakfast.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E4 — Pasta Night
Tonight is pasta night in Bedford; Martha and friends make three pasta dishes, including a recipe from her new restaurant, The Bedford, a no-knife spaghetti, and a lemon angel hair pasta.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E7 — A Classic French Dish: Pot Au Feu
Martha prepares pot-au-feu, a hearty French dish of root vegetables and various cuts of meat, all braised in a savory broth; it's served with sliced meat, vegetables and delicious accompaniments!

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E9 — Vietnamese Cuisine
Martha creates an incredible Vietnamese feast with her friend Monica Tran, including lettuce-wrapped golden fried spring rolls, traditional pho soup, and savory sizzling pancakes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E10 — Sweet and Savory Apple Dishes
Martha makes homemade apple cider, a tender pork roast with apples and braised red cabbage; and of course, we can't have an apple show without dessert.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E1 — Perfect Chicken Dinner
Martha serves up a delicious chicken dinner with fresh ingredients from her greenhouse; joined by her good friend Kevin Sharkey, they celebrate the perfect meal for a taste of home-cooked goodness.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E3 — Pizza Perfection: Sicilian and Neapolitan-Style Pizzas
Martha serves up delicious homemade pizzas alongside friends and pizza chefs Christian Petroni and Dean Medico; featuring classic pizzas, signature sauces, and more.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E10 — Grains
An overview of popular grains including quinoa and bulgur wheat and how to cook them.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E12 — Legumes
Available varieties of legumes, from chickpeas to calypso beans, and how to cook them on the stovetop, in the oven and in a pressure cooker; guest Italian chef Cesare Casella.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:

Chicken paillard; chicken pot pie; spatchcocked chicken.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School

S3 E3 — Roasting
Roast rack of lamb; salt-roasted sea bass; saffron-roasted chicken wings.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E4 — Noodles
Pad thai; one-pan pasta; pho.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E6 — Rice
Paella with chicken, pork, seafood and vegetables; stuffed peppers with fluffy rice, pine nuts, raisins and herbs; Persian rice -- basmati cooked atop potatoes.
